title: Blocked rightward cascade preserves contents
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $j<\ell$, and consider zone contents with left and right words at each of the $\ell$ levels. Suppose each left word at a level $k<j$ fills that zone to capacity, and the left word at level $j$ also fills its zone to capacity. Then the rightward cascade through $j$ levels preserves the concatenated left-side word and the concatenated right-side word.
hypotheses_covered: At every level $k<j$, the left word has length equal to that zone's capacity
At level $j$, the left word has length equal to that zone's capacity
